So you mean the sprite keeps changing, perhaps even its direction?
All events begin with the Move option enabled. This means they shouldn't change at all. Only if you change it to Stop (animation) only it would move without ever changing its current position on the map.
If that's not what you're talking about here, then explain to us what tile model cycle is supposed to be here.
And those screenshots Turan mentioned before would definitely help here.

posts.author: DragonflyMask
posts.body: Ok, I hope this helps. They follow the intended path, it's just the image changes every time they change direction.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
That is ddue to the big monster event not having directions and using the four rows to show different big monsters instead of one monster from  different direction.
a simple fix is to check the box "direction fix" bottom left.
if you want to see the enemy from the side, then you'll need to use a different sprite.
